review.en: Issued without a title or band name on the sleeve, the fourth album holds Stairway to Heaven, Black Dog and When the Levee Breaks, whose drum sound was recorded in a stairwell at Headley Grange. Folk, blues and hard rock sit side by side. It is among the best-selling rock albums and a fixed point for the genre.
review.zh: 第四张专辑封面上既无标题也无乐队名，里面有《Stairway to Heaven》《Black Dog》，还有在海德利庄园楼梯间录下鼓声的《When the Levee Breaks》。民谣、布鲁斯和硬摇滚并排放着。它是销量最高的摇滚专辑之一，也是这一类型的坐标。
